summary: WebRTC black-screen bug FIX validated end-to-end via 2-tab Playwright test (tecnico + cliente) with getDisplayMedia stubbed by a canvas.captureStream fake. All 4 scenarios PASS: (1) client shares first then tec opens; (2) reconnect via close-modal + btn-ver again; (3) click relay still works over live video; (4) inverse order — tec opens BEFORE client clicks COMEÇAR. In every case video-ecra.srcObject becomes non-null AND #video-espera receives class 'oculto' within ~1s. Screenshot confirms actual video pixels rendered in the tec (no black screen).
critical_code_review_comments: ICE queueing on both sides is correctly implemented: cliente.js resets iceQueue and remotoPronto at criarOferta() start, drains on webrtc:answer; tecnico.js drains after createAnswer+setLocalDescription. No 'Failed to execute addIceCandidate' observed.
pc.ontrack -> v.srcObject = ev.streams[0]; v.play() and video-espera.add('oculto') runs synchronously — reliable.

Reconnect path works because abrirVer() re-emits tecnico:ver which triggers server to send tecnico:pronto to the client, and client's criarOferta() closes any prior pc and starts fresh (renegotiation OK).
Minor: server.py webrtc:answer relays to whole room 'sess:{id}' with skip_sid. If two techs watch the same session, both would receive the offerer's answer. Not exercised here but worth noting.
Minor: RTC config is STUN-only (stun.l.google.com). This works in local/preview env but will fail on symmetric NATs in production — add TURN for real-world reliability.

cliente.js socket.on('webrtc:answer') should ideally check remotoPronto/pc state to avoid setRemoteDescription in wrong state on late answers; current code is fine because criarOferta resets before each offer.
seed_data_creation: Two ephemeral sessions created (cliente + cliente2). btn-limpar called before test to clean prior state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To test WebRTC in headless Chromium: use page.add_init_script to override navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia and return canvas.captureStream(10). This yields a real MediaStreamTrack that RTCPeerConnection accepts. Do NOT rely on --use-fake-* Chromium flags because the browser_automation_tool does not expose launch args. Two contexts/pages share localStorage in same context, so wipe localStorage after goto to force a fresh session on second client.
verified_scenarios: Test2 reconnect (close modal + reopen): srcObject=True, esperaOculto=True
Test3 click relay while streaming: .circulo-toque appears on cliente (count=1) AND marca-clique-tec visible on tec
Test4 inverse order (tec opens BEFORE client shares): srcObject=True, esperaOculto=True
